summary: Catron County tower site on Grouse Mountain in the Gila Wilderness, listed as gone by the FFLA; no build, staffing or site history found in the sources read.

facts.status_note: The FFLA lists the tower as gone; no source read says what, if anything, remains at the site

access.note: The peak lies in the Gila Wilderness and is reached by the Holt Apache Trail per Wikipedia; no source describes access to the former tower site

visit.trail_note: Holt Apache Trail, about 7 miles southeast of Mogollon (route to the peak, per Wikipedia)

notes_for_editor: Thin record. Support is the FFLA New Mexico list entry (Tower, Gone), a Forest Lookouts page that gives only the name, county and agency, and a Wikipedia article about the peak, which does not mention a lookout. Searches found no build date, staffing history or account of the site. Search hits for 'Grouse Mtn. Fire Lookout' pages (Idaho, Montana) concern other towers and were not used. Record kind 'tower', agency Gila National Forest and county Catron match the sources; no correction proposed. The 'public' access level rests on the peak's wilderness status and the Holt Apache Trail route, not on any description of the former tower site. Next step if someone wants a fuller story: look for a Gila National Forest fire lookout history or Forest records.
